concept: A person is shown as a round object resting on the pane, lifted by a rim of light like the panes themselves.

root.why: the round frame with a light rim makes the face an object on the pane instead of a hole in it

sm.why: small size sits beside names in lists and posts, where the name already identifies the person

md.why: medium size is the 44px touch size, used when the avatar itself opens a profile

lg.why: large size overlaps the cover by half its height so the person reads as in front of their own scene

img.why: the photo fills the circle and covers it fully, so no frame colour competes with the face
